marks.text_zh: 17:30 各部在混乱中开始撤退突围；多数涌向下关，粤军第66、83军向东北的太平门集结
marks.text_en: 17:30 the units begin to leave in chaos; most rush for Xiaguan, the two Cantonese corps gather at Taiping Gate in the north-east
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F28, raw_fights_south_east#13 (the Cantonese going to Taiping Gate: zh.wikipedia 南京保卫战)

marks.text_zh: 傍晚：日军第16师团占着紫金山的山头；紫金山从17:20起大火，夜里照亮东北角
marks.text_en: Dusk: the Japanese 16th Division holds the peaks of Purple Mountain; the mountain burns from about 17:20 and lights the north-east at night
marks.label: 未核实
marks.src: jp-032 (the highest peak taken 15:00-18:00 printed), timeline fires fire-1212-zijinshan (Kojima 1984 via en.wikipedia) | label 未核实 (wave H reconcile): the weakest claim of the mark, the mountain fire, has no checked source; the summit hour is 核实 as in bs-1208-zijinshan

marks.text_zh: 傍晚太平门被人群堵住；教导总队的人退出门洞，该队一个营700多人到夜里只剩200多（回忆，未核实）
marks.text_en: At dusk the gate is jammed with troops; the Training Corps men are pushed out of the passage, a battalion of 700-plus down to 200-plus (a memoir)
marks.label: 未核实
marks.src: raw_cn_heavy#27, raw_cn_ground#38 (石怀瑜, secretchina 2003, single memoir, low confidence); the Training Corps pulling back into the city caused confusion (叶肇 report, zh.wikipedia note 60)

marks.text_zh: 20:00 前后叶肇、罗策群亲自督队拆除堵门的沙袋
marks.text_en: About 20:00 Ye Zhao and Luo Cequn direct the taking down of the sandbags that block the gate
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: raw_cn_heavy#29 (叶肇 report quoted in zh.wikipedia note 60), F27

marks.text_en: 20:30 the sandbags are down; the gate stands open
marks.label: 推测
marks.src: wall.json gates taiping seal ends 12 Dec 20:30 (推测 hour, from the 20:00-21:00 readings of F27)

marks.text_zh: 约21:00 纵队的排头出城（另一说原定23:00；还有一说第83军13日06:00才突围）
marks.text_en: About 21:00 the head of the column goes out (en.wikipedia: planned for 23:00; another account: the 83rd Corps broke out at 06:00 on 13 Dec)
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F27 (about 20:00-21:00, planned 23:00), raw_fights_south_east#12, raw_fights_south_east#13; the 06:00 reading raw_cn_ground#37 conflicts_with (吴相湘), 未核实

marks.text_zh: 约21:40 排头在紫金山东北岔路口遇到日军火力封锁，几次冲击都没有成功
marks.text_en: About 21:40 the head meets the Japanese fire blockade at the north-east fork; several charges fail
marks.label: 推测
marks.src: zh.wikipedia note 61 citing 《死里求生》 via research/stories_1120/battle_taiping_breakout.md (the hours are 推测)

marks.text_zh: 约午夜：代理师长罗策群在岔路口举起马鞭，用粤语大呼「跟我来」，冲在最前面，阵亡（钟点为推测；远景，不近拍）
marks.text_en: About midnight: Luo Cequn, acting commander of the 159th Division, raises his riding crop at the fork and calls out in Cantonese "Follow me", at the head of the charge, and falls (the hour is 推测; seen only from a distance)
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: raw_cn_ground#37, zh.wikipedia bio of 罗策群 citing 《死里求生》 note 61 (the quote and the place are the source's; "about twelve" is 推测); the picture target (plan wall B7)

marks.text_zh: 小股人员在黑暗里绕过哨位；全部12,500人中约3,000-4,000人冲了出去（英文维基；叶肇报告称第159、160师尚有7,800人，两说冲突）
marks.text_en: Small groups slip past in the dark; of the 12,500 about 3,000-4,000 get out (en.wikipedia; Ye Zhao's report gives 7,800 still with the 159th and 160th, the two disagree)
marks.label: 未核实
marks.src: en.wikipedia via research/vo/FACT_DIGEST.md (S13), OOB.md 3.6 (INV a3); the way past is 推测

marks.text_zh: 约两小时后太平门洞开，空无一人（回忆，未核实）
marks.text_en: About two hours later the gate stands open and empty (a memoir)
marks.label: 未核实

marks.text_zh: 次日（13日）：太平门外被缴械的人被看押，门边约1,300人被杀——另一事件，这里不画
marks.text_en: The next day (13 Dec): disarmed men are held outside the gate and about 1,300 are killed at it: other events (ev-1213-prisoners-ne, ev-1213-taipingmen-massacre), not drawn here
marks.label: 推测
marks.src: ev-1213-prisoners-ne, ev-1213-taipingmen-massacre (Nakajima diary via zh.wikipedia, ja.wikipedia; attributed); that the men left on the road are the men of the 13th is 推测
